source_surface: test/performance/specs/post-editor.spec.js afterAll results attachment; test/performance/config/performance-reporter.ts raw and curated result files
existing_capability: Specs can attach raw JSON, and the reporter already preserves a raw results file before curating q25/q50/q75 arrays.
required_change: Add a replay sidecar attachment or raw-only field for per-event histories and per-sample metadata; keep curated q50 output as a derived summary.
why_required: The current curated reporter schema is metric-array-oriented; replay needs event records, assertions, owner spans, and document/session context.
shortcut_to_avoid: Do not squeeze event histories into one metric array or only keep aggregate q50s.

existing_capability: Metrics already starts Chromium tracing and extracts EventDispatch durations by event type.
required_change: Keep per-event trace windows and identifiers, not only duration arrays; optionally add richer trace categories only for replay diagnostics.
why_required: Replay has to join an editing event to source spans, visual endpoints, async work, and behavior assertions.
shortcut_to_avoid: Do not treat unkeyed EventDispatch durations as replay samples once actions are heterogeneous.

existing_capability: The current typing tests can synthesize repeated fixed text with a delay, and pressKeys covers shortcuts plus clipboard emulation.
required_change: Build a replay executor that consumes event records: text insertion, complete keypress, shortcut, paste, click, selection/navigation, transform, and structural actions.
why_required: Human/plugin replay is heterogeneous; a single held-key type('xxxxx') loop cannot preserve event type, gap, hold, composition, or target context.
shortcut_to_avoid: Do not use Playwright held-key delay as the default human replay path.

existing_capability: PerfUtils can load HTML fixtures, generate synthetic 1000-paragraph posts, save drafts, reopen posts, and disable autosave.
required_change: Add a manifest-driven materializer for document shape, post type, selected block context, plugin/theme set, viewport, autosave state, and session age.
why_required: Latency ownership changes with document shape and editor state; replay must reconstruct enough state to make event histories comparable.
shortcut_to_avoid: Do not replay all histories on the existing large-post fixture.

source_surface: Current performance specs mostly push durations; e2e editor helpers expose selection/content actions
existing_capability: Existing tests can inspect edited content, selected blocks, visible UI, and save state when a spec asks for it.
required_change: Define assertion packs per stratum: text delta, selection/caret, block-tree hash, visible list/appender, template/editing mode, undo, pattern binding, plugin-visible side effects, and focus.
why_required: Replay speedups are invalid if the action does not produce the same editor state.
shortcut_to_avoid: Do not accept a latency improvement from a replay sample with failed or missing behavior assertions.

source_surface: No current general human-session recorder in the performance harness; typing-delay benchmark has one-off in-page event/source instrumentation
existing_capability: Source-span and event instrumentation exists for diagnostics, but it is tied to the synthetic typing-delay benchmark.
required_change: Factor an opt-in recorder that emits redacted editing-event records plus document/session context and source/visual IDs.
why_required: Recorded histories are needed before fixed-x source rankings can become product latency rankings.
shortcut_to_avoid: Do not call synthetic generated sequences representative human/plugin histories.

source_surface: test/performance/config/performance-reporter.ts curateResults; report R pipeline derived CSVs and figures
existing_capability: The existing reporter stores raw JSON and curated q50 summaries; the R pipeline can add derived decision tables and figures.
required_change: Report per-stratum p50/p90, owner-rank deltas, visual/behavior endpoints, assertion failures, sample counts, and environment metadata before any aggregate score.
why_required: A product claim needs per-stratum pass/fail and owner ranking; one scalar hides regressions.
shortcut_to_avoid: Do not average ordinary text, correction, selection, paste, transform, and plugin side effects into one headline without stratum tables.
